title: Code and data for "MOEA and SA-MOEA for cash-dividend portfolios: evidence from Vietnamese equities"
description: Implementation, instance data and run files accompanying the manuscript "MOEA and SA-MOEA for cash-dividend portfolios: evidence from Vietnamese equities" (second revision). The archive contains the multi-period dividend-portfolio model; the GA, NSGA-II, SPEA2, NSGA-III and MOEA/D solvers with SA injection, random-injection controls, elite-anchored variants and a sensitivity check of the SA starting temperature; the exact small-instance mixed-integer linear program; seven instances (VN30 and HNX30 for 2023, 2024 and 2025, and VN30+HNX30 for 2023) derived from public HOSE and HNX trading records; all run files; and the analysis scripts that regenerate the paper's tables and figures. Code is released under the MIT license; data and run files under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md).
